async function more(i) { return i < 3; }
async function save(i) {}
function use(i) {}
let i = 0;
async function f_let1_cond_semi(n) {
  for (let i = 0; await more(i); i++);
}
async function f_let1_cond_empty(n) {
  for (let i = 0; await more(i); i++) {}
}
async function f_let1_cond_stmt(n) {
  for (let i = 0; await more(i); i++) { use(i); }
}
async function f_let1_upd_semi(n) {
  for (let i = 0; i < n; await save(i), i++);
}
async function f_let1_upd_empty(n) {
  for (let i = 0; i < n; await save(i), i++) {}
}

  for (let i = 0; i < n; await save(i), i++) { use(i); }
}
